rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the person or company responsible for making goods.

example.english: The manufacturer of this phone provides a three-year warranty.
example.traditional: 呢部手機嘅生產商提供咗三年保養。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 sang1 caan2 soeng1 tai4 gung1 zo2 saam1 nin4 bou2 joeng5

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress the physical manufacturing of a product, especially in product information or specifications.

example.english: The manufacturer is listed on the product packaging.
example.traditional: 產品包裝上列明製造商係邊間公司。
example.jyutping: caan2 ban2 baau1 zong1 soeng6 lit6 ming4 zai3 zou6 soeng1 hai6 bin1 gaan1 gung1 si1

rows.note: Use this when referring to the industrial firm or factory-side business that makes or supplies the goods.

example.english: This batch of parts is supplied by a local manufacturer.
example.traditional: 呢批零件係由本地廠商供應嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 pai1 ling4 gin6 hai6 jau4 bun2 dei6 cong2 soeng1 gung1 jing3 ge3
